mapper.insert: insert into t_kb_chunk (enterprise_id, document_id, chunk_index, content, token_count, vector_ref, embedding, embedding_model, dim, create_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{documentId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{tokenCount}, #{vectorRef}, #{embedding}, #{embeddingModel}, #{dim}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select c.chunk_id, c.enterprise_id, c.document_id, c.chunk_index, c.page_no, c.content, c.token_count, c.vector_ref, c.embedding, c.embedding_model, c.dim, c.create_time, d.title as doc_title from t_kb_chunk c join t_kb_document d on d.document_id = c.document_id and d.del_flag = '0' where c.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}

select chunk_id, enterprise_id, document_id, chunk_index, page_no, content, token_count, vector_ref, embedding_model, dim, create_time from t_kb_chunk where document_id = #{documentId} order by chunk_index
select count(1) from t_kb_chunk where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}
